_ConnectionStrings_note: Password is injected at runtime (ConnectionStrings__App via env var / user-secrets); never committed. Single pol_app principal for every runtime cluster (task 8, '1 principal' — RLS teardown retired the separate pol_admin bypass role).
_AdminSession_note: Admin SPA origins the host needs outside authentication (the section keeps its name so AdminSession__WebAppBaseUrl env keys are unchanged). WebAppBaseUrl = the admin console origin; ScalarBaseUrl = the Development-only Scalar UI origin. Employee login itself is IdentityAccess (below).
_MerchantAuth_note: Merchant-user BFF login (producer-google-sso REQ-8/9/14/17). A confidential OIDC client, fully isolated from the employee IdentityAccess login: a distinct 'MerchantUserMicrosoft' scheme + /api/v1/merchants/auth/microsoft/callback + mch_* cookies. Microsoft is the ONLY supported provider (Google was retired); any other configured provider is rejected at boot outside Development. The secret is injected at runtime (MerchantAuth__Providers__Microsoft__ClientSecret), never committed. A blank ClientId -> the scheme is skipped (login disabled) rather than faulting the host. RegisterUrl is the merchant-user SPA register page the callback redirects an applicant to with a signed ticket. Microsoft Authority is injected via env (MerchantAuth__Providers__Microsoft__Authority) and MUST be the tenant-pinned Entra External ID (CIAM) v2.0 endpoint — multi-tenant authorities are rejected at boot; blank + blank ClientId = provider disabled. AllowedTenants is an optional extra tid gate.
_IdentityAccess_note: Employee login (the only admin console credential): Microsoft Entra workforce OIDC at the API (IdentityAccess:Workforce, tenant-pinned Authority; the secret is injected as IdentityAccess__Workforce__ClientSecret, never committed; Production requires ClientId/ClientSecret/CallbackPath and a WorkforceTenantId equal to the authority tenant). Tier 0 validates exactly one tid and oid, resolves the immutable tenant-aware tuple, treats Email as optional non-unique contact data, and does not derive authorization from roles claims. Then OpenIddict authorization code + PKCE issues the workforce SPA (client_id WorkforceClientId) a platform access JWT and an opaque refresh token; the SPA sends Authorization: Bearer, no cookie or CSRF pair. AccessTokenMinutes is the JWT lifetime (authorization is re-checked from the database every request). RefreshTokenMinutes is the refresh token lifetime; every refresh issues a new refresh token with the full lifetime, so a session slides while in use and ends this long after the last refresh. Production keeps 480 (8h); dev overrides to 1440 via launchSettings (IdentityAccess__RefreshTokenMinutes). Workforce/Agent OIDC providers and the SPA origins are injected via env, see launchSettings.json. OAuth:Issuer MUST be pinned to the API's public origin (dev: https://localhost:5001 via launchSettings OAuth__Issuer): without it OpenIddict derives the issuer from each request's (forwarded) host, so a code or token issued to a request that reached the API directly is rejected (invalid_grant / 401) by one that arrived through the SPA proxy, and vice versa.
_MerchantSession_note: Server-side merchant-user session lifetime + cookie posture (SameSite=Lax assumes merchant-user SPA + API same-site).
_Cors_note: Browser SPA frontend origins. MerchantOrigins = merchant-user console (cookie XHR, credentialed — the default policy); AdminOrigins = admin console (cookie XHR, credentialed). Empty here (no cross-origin allowed); set per env via Cors__MerchantOrigins__0 / Cors__AdminOrigins__0.
_AuditAnchor_note: Signed audit high-water checkpoints are stored outside SQL. Development/Testing may leave both values blank. Every other environment must mount a persistent append-only path and a separate non-zero 32-byte base64 signing-key file.
_Psp_note: Non-secret PSP endpoint/environment config (Payments.Infrastructure/Psp/PspOptions.cs). PublicBaseUrl is this API's public origin; the per-connection backend-notification URL handed to a PSP is derived from it ({PublicBaseUrl}/api/v1/webhooks/{pspConnectionId}). Blank here so the local host and the test suite boot on the committed defaults; set per env via Psp__PublicBaseUrl. Outside Development a blank or non-absolute value fails fast at boot (captive-payment-alignment REQ-4.3/4.6).
